messages.body: Inline receiving count KL-044: DL-044-P1, P2 and P3 accepted; P4 absent. Expected four pallets, received three. The count is signed in our business portal.
Please trace DL-044-P4 separately. We can receive the missing pallet on 2026-03-18 afternoon at the same receiving bay.
Trace DL-044-P4 and arrange its remaining delivery to the verified KL-044 receiving bay. Current signed count is three of four; do not close using P1–P3 alone.
P4 was held on a separate transfer trailer. We located it and scheduled the remaining delivery for 2026-03-18, 13:00–16:00 UTC.
Please stop the P4 delivery for now. Our buyer is deciding whether to reject the whole consignment. Do not send P4 tomorrow until I confirm. I am not asking for a return yet.

Kestrel Loom has asked us to stop the DL-044-P4 delivery until Eron Leth confirms. Please do not dispatch P4 on 2026-03-18. Is P4 already loaded for that run? This is a hold only, not a rejection or return of the consignment, and the trace stays open.

DL-044-P4 was not loaded. It is held at our transfer depot and removed from the 2026-03-18 run, with Eron Leth recorded as owner of the stop. The trace stays open. No rejection, return or refund has been recorded.
